method.counters: Windows Get-Process TotalProcessorTime, WorkingSet64 and PrivateMemorySize64
method.cpu: API CPU delta is exact to the process counter resolution. PostgreSQL sums observed maximum CPU per PID/start-time minus initial baseline; backends created during the run start at zero. Short-lived processes and CPU after their final observed sample may be missed.
method.memory: Peak sampled working sets are observations, not continuous peaks. PostgreSQL aggregate working sets can double-count shared memory and are not unique physical RAM.
method.scope: Resource totals include all six cases, fixture setup, between-case reconciliation and scraping; latency/throughput exclude setup. PostgreSQL counters include the whole shared native cluster, including idle demo API and background workers. Host processes and caches were not controlled.
method.sampling_overhead: Sampler, CLI load generator, API, database and other desktop applications share the host. No claim of production capacity or statistically stable benchmark is made.
